SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description: One ordered page of publication summaries, with count, effective paging information and optional facet counts.

page.title: page
page.description: Effective one-based page for this response.

total.title: total
total.description: Matching indexed publications after query and filters, before pagination. May be incomplete when search_cutoff is true. An exact total can exceed the retrieval window.

per_page.title: per_page
per_page.description: Effective requested page size, not the number of returned hits.

facet_counts.title: facet_counts
facet_counts.description: Facet values and counts for the query and filters, independently of hit pagination. The number of returned facet values may be limited.

search_cutoff.title: search_cutoff
search_cutoff.description: Whether search stopped early. When true, hits or total may be incomplete.

licenses.title: licenses
licenses.description: Reported license names or standard identifiers such as Apache-2.0. Empty means no information supplied. The list specifies neither AND nor OR combination semantics.

name.title: name
name.description: Short catalog identifier, qualified by namespace. The namespace/name pair identifies the same ontology across releases. URLs must not be derived from this identifier.

description.title: description
description.description: Short description of the ontology's domain and intended use.

base_url.title: base_url
base_url.description: Permanent absolute URL identifying one exact immutable publication. GET this exact URL returns its publication JSON. Do not append a filename.

version.title: version
version.description: Complete publication version label, including amendments.

formats.title: formats
formats.description: Formats of the publication's available artifacts. Each value identifies both the ontology language and serialization syntax, as in artifact.format.

published_at.title: published_at
published_at.description: First successful Hub publication time for this immutable release. Backend emits UTC date-time text with Z. Consumers accept timezone-bearing RFC 3339 text. Fixed for the lifetime of this publication. Not an upstream release date.

namespace.title: namespace
namespace.description: Namespace qualifying the ontology name, such as w3c in w3c/prov-o.

FacetCount.title: FacetCount
FacetCount.description: Counts for the returned values of one indexed field.

field_name.title: field_name
field_name.description: Indexed field used for this facet.

FacetValueCount.title: FacetValueCount
FacetValueCount.description: A facet value and its matching-publication count.

count.title: count
count.description: Number of matching publications for this facet value or range.

Format.title: Format
Format.description: A combination of ontology language and syntax.

title: Publication search result
description: One page of ungrouped publication search results, with the matching count and effective pagination settings and optional facet counts.
